value.rationale: The theorem gives an exact universal comparative-statics structure in graph reinforcement: any single leaf clock change has a strict alternating nonlocal response through every branch, for arbitrary positive heterogeneous rates and every sublinear exponent strictly between zero and one. The bottom-up recursion computes actual susceptibilities, and the alpha=0 contrast shows the effect is reinforcement-driven. This is motivated by interpretation and sensitivity of the just-proved homogeneous limits, not arbitrary coefficient extraction or routine numerical tabulation.
